headline: Approved park namings at Rogers Fort Hill Park, Saint Louis Park, 68 Jackson Street, North Common, and Tyler Park, plus dozens of event and sports permits.
summary: The Board of Parks reviewed requests for park and field use permits from many residents, churches, and youth sports leagues, approving most with fees, waivers, or fee reductions by 4-0 or 3-1 votes. The board also approved five park naming and monument requests from the Lowell DPD Monument Committee. Several cricket league permit requests and two flag football field requests were held over or carried to the next meeting, and five items were declined because no one appeared to represent them.
decisions: Declined the Lowell Angels Baseball request for Cawley Memorial Stadium Complex-Alumni Field because no one attended to represent it.
Declined the Destiny Santana baby shower request for Shedd Park Pavilion because no one attended to represent it.
Approved waiving the $200 fee for Janneh Peters-Beedoe's canceled June 27th permit, 4-0.
Declined the Maria Claudio Roberto Clemente League Baseball request for North Common 50/70 Baseball Field because no one attended.
Declined the LHS Athletics request to add time at Cawley Memorial Stadium Complex-Machado Field because no one attended.
Approved LHS Athletics' request to give back Sunday dates at the Rizos Turf Field while keeping Sunday October 25, 2026, 4-0.
Approved James O'Keefe/UTEC's request for Stoklosa School Park Basketball Court II for $75, 4-0.
Approved James O'Keefe/UTEC's request for North Common 50/70 Baseball Field with new times for a $50 fee, 4-0.
Approved Levi Tankersley/Community Connections' car wash fundraiser at Cawley Memorial Stadium Complex-Alumni Field, 4-0.
Approved the Back to School Event providing backpacks at Gage Field I, Gage Volleyball Court, and Gage Basketball Court, 4-0.
Approved Haley McGuire's 2nd birthday party at Shedd Park Pavilion, 4-0.
Approved bundling all Matthew LeLacheur/LYBSL field dates at Father Maguire Mahoney Field, McPherson Park M1 and M2, Shedd Park Page Field, and Ventura Softball Field, 4-0.
Approved waiving the permit fee for 'Lowell Loves Wildlife,' reducing the cost to $200, 4-0.
Approved Aurora Valentin's birthday party at Muldoon Park Gazebo with no fee, 3-1 with Tom Caunter dissenting.
Approved Joe Cady's annual bike race at Shedd Park Pavilion and Track, 4-0.
Carried Mike Marshall/LPD Flag Football's request for Scullin Park Greenspace and Reilly School Community Playground Field to the next meeting.
Carried Mike Marshall/LPD Flag Football's request for Campbell Senior League Baseball Field and Gage Park Whalen Senior League Field to the next meeting.
Approved Bruna Costa's Pilates class at Fort Hill Park Greenspace, 4-0.
Approved Iva Keo's birthday party at Manning Field, 4-0.
Approved Mark Clinton/Lowell Pop Warner's new dates and reduced fee of $100 for the Rizos Turf Field, 4-0.
Approved waiving the $800 fee for Mark Clinton/Lowell Pop Warner's relinquished dates at the Rizos Turf Field, 4-0.
Approved naming a small area at the top of Fort Hill in Rogers Fort Hill Park and adding a plaque reading 'Lowell Garden of Peace,' 4-0.
Approved dedicating the Splash Pad and Playground at Saint Louis Park to the Conant Family ('Janice and Scott Conant Sr.'), 4-0.
Approved naming the park at 68 Jackson Street 'Bicentennial Park: A Tribute to Lowell Women,' 4-0.
Approved installing a new bench at North Common in memory of Beau Jaynes, 4-0.
Approved the location of a monument at Tyler Park honoring Nancy and Bernie Judge, 4-0.
Approved Violet Russ/Full Deliverance Church's worship service at Kerouac Park Greenspace with no fee, 4-0.
Declined Maxima Rosario's Church Kids Day request for Fort Hill Park Greenspace because no one attended.
Approved Sambath Bo/Clemente Park Committee's free community event at Clemente Park Picnic Area with no fee, 4-0.
Approved Hetal Patel's adult cricket request at Hovey Field for August 1-September 1 dates only, extending current permits, 4-0.
Approved bundling all of Hetal Patel's youth cricket dates at Hovey Field, 4-0.
Took no vote on Hetal Patel's August 15 adult cricket request because the date was already approved for another user through an extended permit.
Approved a $150 credit to Hetal Patel for rain dates on 5/9/26, 5/23/26, and 6/6/26, 4-0.
Approved Sabeeh Ehsan's adult cricket request at Hovey Field for August 1-September 1 dates only, extending current permits, 4-0.
Held over Sabeeh Ehsan's September 5-6 adult cricket request to the next meeting.
Held over Sabeeh Ehsan's September/October adult cricket request (13 dates) to the next meeting.
Held over Sabeeh Ehsan's September/October Sunday adult cricket request to the next meeting.
Approved bundling Sabeeh Ehsan's October 18 and 25 youth cricket dates, 4-0.
Approved bundling Sabeeh Ehsan's November 1, 8, and 15 youth cricket dates, 4-0.
Held over Sabeeh Ehsan's request for Saturdays September 12-October 24, which conflicted with another user, to the next meeting.
Approved Sabeeh Ehsan's credit request for cancelled permits due to rain on April 19, May 3, May 9, May 30, and May 31, 2026, 4-0.
Approved bundling Sabeeh Ehsan's Wednesday youth cricket dates in August and September, 4-0.
